<header class="page-heading"><p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p><h1>Notice of Appearance</h1><p>Use this short-form notice when counsel or another authorized representative enters an appearance in a District Court matter.</p></header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> Confirm that the person entering an appearance is authorized to do so and include any information required by the presiding court.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>[CASE CAPTION]</h2><p>Case No. [DOCKET NUMBER]</p></div>
    <h2>NOTICE OF APPEARANCE</h2>
    <p>Please take notice that <span class="template-placeholder">[NAME]</span> hereby enters an appearance on behalf of <span class="template-placeholder">[PARTY]</span> in the above-captioned matter.</p>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Name</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Name]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Represented party</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Party]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Title / office</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Title, agency, firm, or office]</span></div>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Respectfully submitted</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Name]<br>[Title / counsel status]<br>[Date]</p></section>
  </div>
</article>
